risk: Rendered investigation-workspace UI is unverified for responsive layout, accessibility tree and screen-reader safety, and disclosure leakage across DOM, clipboard, browser title, and telemetry. No operator UI ships in v1, so the risk is latent: it materializes only if a rendered workspace is later built and shipped without first running stories 3.8A, 3.8B, and 3.8C against it.
compensatingControl: Data-layer non-disclosure is proven across stories 3.1 through 3.7 with permission-safe read DTOs, fail-closed degradation, and normalized forbidden-vocabulary checks; operational telemetry redaction and cardinality bounds are proven in stories 6.8A and 6.8B. v1 delivers a headless module (contract package plus .NET client); adopters render their own UI and inherit the documented non-disclosure read contract.
buyerImpact: Buyers integrating the headless v1 module receive contract-level non-disclosure guarantees and run their own rendered-surface verification for responsive, accessibility, and leakage safety against any UI they build. No operator UI is delivered or certified in v1.
